mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_chat (id, group_name, owner_id, avatar) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupName}, #{ownerId}, #{avatar})
INSERT IGNORE INTO group_chat_member (id, group_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{id}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{role})

INSERT IGNORE INTO group_chat_member (id, group_id, user_id, role) VALUES
(#{member.id}, #{member.groupId}, #{member.userId}, #{member.role})
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_name, owner_id, avatar, create_time, update_time FROM group_chat WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, group_id, user_id, role, last_read_message_id, join_time FROM group_chat_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, group_id, user_id, role, last_read_message_id, join_time FROM group_chat_member WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY role DESC, join_time ASC

SELECT gc.id, gc.group_name, gc.owner_id, gc.avatar, gc.create_time, gc.update_time FROM group_chat gc INNER JOIN group_chat_member gcm ON gc.id = gcm.group_id WHERE gcm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY gc.update_time DESC
